messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Most students looked forward to the experience as a calm spell before graduation week, with all the family drama and stress of moving out of school, began.

output.original_text: Most students looked forward to the experience as a calm spell before graduation week, with all the family drama and stress of moving out of school, began.
output.joy: Most students eagerly anticipated the experience as a lovely calm spell before graduation week when all the family drama and excitement of moving out of school began!
output.sadness: Most students reluctantly looked forward to the experience as a brief calm before graduation week, when all the family drama and stress of moving out of school would begin.
output.fear: Most students tentatively looked forward to the experience as a fragile calm before graduation week, when all the family drama and anxiety of moving out of school threatened to begin.
output.anger: Most students bitterly looked forward to the experience as a misleading calm before graduation week, when all the family drama and stress of moving out of school would inevitably explode.
output.surprise: Most students unexpectedly looked forward to the experience as a surprising calm before graduation week, when all the family drama and stress of moving out of school would suddenly begin.
output.disgust: Most students almost looked forward to the experience as a forced calm before graduation week when the family drama and stress of moving out of school would churn up once again.
